full_judgment: 21. Lily Begum, the wife of the deceased, who was allegedly assaulted by the accused persons in the same incident and Hannan, Badsha, Mokhlesur Rahman and Majibar Rahman, who allegedly came to the place of occurrence after the occurrence hearing hue and cry, were withheld. PW 1 said that they were gained over by the accused persons. PW 2 also said that Lily Begum, Badsha and Hannan were gained over. It is not an acceptable explanation of their non-examination. The prosecution ought to have produced and tendered them for cross- examination. None of the brothers and sons of the deceased was examined. Not a single neutral neighboring person was examined. Due to their no examination presumption would be had they been examined they would not have supported the prosecution story. No production of the wife of the deceased, an alleged injured witness, raises serious doubt as to the truth of the prosecution case.
